scope.initial_dns_denial: The same two query URLs failed before network permission, then succeeded unchanged; no third query.

FedRoD.exact_training: CE(g + gamma * log N_m, y); candidate gamma=1 and +1 smoothing is a variant of this established training objective
FedRoD.state: phi_m is a learned local FC head, kept across rounds; personal ERM gradients do not update theta or psi
FedRoD.hyper: learned and aggregated hypernetwork H(a_m; nu) maps class proportions to phi_m
FedRoD.match_boundary: Explicit BSM generic / personalized scheme and class-frequency-conditioned no-further-training adaptation. No read equation fixes hP to log(n+1). Not an absence proof.

MenonLA.training: CE(f+tau log pi,y), raw f at inference (Eq10)
MenonLA.boundary: non-PFL atomic source; Bayes log target/source adaptation is an existing algebraic consequence, not candidate novelty; Sec5.3 warns against removing the source prior again after a balanced loss

FedBalance.formula: Eq3 CE(phi_i(x)+alpha_i psi_i(x),y), alpha uses class frequency
FedBalance.boundary: private weak learner psi is trained by backpropagation (Alg1), not a fixed analytic prior vector; not an exact candidate

MuPFL.formula: SecIII-E PKCF uploads averaged per-class feature gradients (Eq16), server creates global features, client classifier takes gradient steps Eq21
MuPFL.boundary: learned classifier / transmitted statistics, not no-gradient analytic prior adaptation

FedNoRo.fact: local f+log pi is training; LA baseline named FedLA with Menon2021 reference. Acronym alone does not identify a unique PFL method

FedLC.fact: local margin calibration with -tau*n_c^(-1/4); not the same loss as BSM and does not automatically imply uniform-posterior raw logits

formula_boundary.q: q_ic=(n_ic+1)/(n_i+C); log(n_ic+1) differs from log q only by a clientwise constant
formula_boundary.extra_pool_subtraction_after_BSM: changes target prior to proportional q_i/pi_pool unless pool is exactly uniform; near-uniform means approximate, not constant
formula_boundary.conditions: calibrated source posterior, shared p(x|y), accurate target/source priors, support, optimization. Smoothing and missing classes weaken the exact interpretation. Analytic bias is not an entire classifier and still uses local class-count state.

minimum_controls: CE and FedLC with same prior; CE standard target/source correction explicitly
FedRoD-linear nearest-neighbor with matched body/communication budget and reported extra compute/state
Frozen-body lastLinear local1epoch, evaluate raw and same prior; not equivalent to FedRoD or automatically equal compute
paper_position: Combination study of known smoothed BSM, analytic prior adaptation, and low-bit EF. The two-query finite check did not locate the whole same-formula same-compressor implementation. Do not rename an exact prior combination as a new algorithm; no nonexistence or effect claim.
